**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Wurundjeri Woi-wurrung people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

Speedcubing Australia is delighted to announce that Spark Education is sponsoring the upcoming Spark Melbourne Spring Series 2024 competitions.
Spark Education is introducing the Spark Cubing Club, making its grand debut during the competiton. Their club is dedicated to bringing together cubers of all skill levels, building a supportive and fun environment for everyone.

Spark Education will also be providing prizes for All Podium Winners!

Don't miss this incredible opportunity to be part of something special. We look forward to seeing you there!

## LVA students, staff, and faculty must leave their LVA email as a comment on their registration to qualify for free registration. There are no exceptions. 

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
